Count direct calls only (no callbacks) and exclude `_send_single_request` itself. Give their symbol IDs.

sql: SELECT DISTINCT r.caller_symbol_id AS symbol_id FROM code.reachability r JOIN code.symbols t ON t.symbol_id = r.target_symbol_id JOIN code.symbols c ON c.symbol_id = r.caller_symbol_id WHERE t.file_id = 'httpx/_client.py' AND t.qualname = 'Client._send_single_request' AND r.direct_depth IS NOT NULL AND c.file_id = 'httpx/_client.py' AND r.caller_symbol_id <> r.target_symbol_id ORDER BY symbol_id
